purpose: Check whether the type-I error depends on the permutation count B.
conclusion: The type-I error is ~0.04-0.05 and does NOT depend on B (200 vs 5000 are identical). The full Monte Carlo's 0.080 (n=300, a different seed) was Monte-Carlo noise, not a finite-B artifact. The confirmatory permutation test (B=10,000, two-sided alpha=0.05) is calibrated at ~0.05.
